Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quant ity will be awarded to MSEs. ii. Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within range of L1+15 % price , then 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amongst them. .
